# SPGuides

> > Practical troubleshooting guides and tutorials for Microsoft SharePoint administration and development

SPGuides.com provides solutions to common SharePoint errors, configuration issues, and implementation challenges. The site focuses on helping SharePoint administrators and developers resolve technical problems with step-by-step guidance.

## Key Topics

- SharePoint
- ActiveX controls
- Browser compatibility
- Spreadsheet import
- SharePoint errors
- SharePoint administration
- Import troubleshooting
- Legacy browser features
- SharePoint configuration
- Technical support

## Troubleshooting & Error Resolution

- [Cannot import spreadsheet into SharePoint. This feature requires a browser that supports ActiveX controls](https://spguides.com/this-feature-requires-a-browser-that-supports-activex-controls-sharepoint): Fix SharePoint spreadsheet import error with ActiveX controls compatibility
